en.title: Hidden Camera Found in Accessible Toilet Sparks Privacy and Accessibility Concerns
en.summary: A hidden camera was discovered inside a potted plant in an accessible toilet, secretly filming 25 users and raising serious privacy and accessibility concerns. In other news, Australia extended its Disability Representative Program for two years, Microsoft announced major accessibility upgrades to PowerPoint, Bolt launched e‑scooter‑based maps for wheelchair‑accessible routes, and SMA patients highlighted three wheelchair travel obstacles at a concert.

highlights.title: Hidden camera discovered in accessible toilet's potted plant, secretly filming 25 users
Disability Representative Program Extended for Two Years
Microsoft makes major accessibility improvement in PowerPoint
Bolt Turns E‑scooters into Maps for Wheelchair Accessibility
SMA patients attend concert, reveal three wheelchair travel obstacles; public photo campaign promotes environmental accessibility

zh-TW.title: 無障礙廁所偷拍針孔攝影機被揭露
zh-TW.summary: 無障礙廁所的盆栽內被發現藏有針孔攝影機，秘密拍攝了25人使用廁所的畫面，引發隱私與無障礙設施安全的廣泛關注。同時，澳洲延長殘障代表計畫兩年，微軟宣布 PowerPoint 重大無障礙更新，Bolt 推出以電子滑板車數據製作輪椅無障礙地圖，以及《平行與垂直》電影將提供日語無障礙字幕。

highlights.title: 無障礙廁所盆栽藏針孔！偷拍25人如廁　噁大叔下場曝
殘障代表計畫延長兩年
微軟在 PowerPoint 中推出重大無障礙改進
Bolt 將電子滑板車變成輪椅無障礙地圖
《Parallel and Perpendicular》的無障礙日文字幕
